title: Immersive Aircraft Structures
description: Structures for Immersive Aircraft and Machinery.
body:
This mod adds various structures for most of the vehicles from the mods:
- [Immersive Aircraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft)
- [Immersive Machinery](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-machinery) (Optional)

Structure generation is compatible with:
- [Deeper and Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker)

See it in action in the Galery.

You can edit structure distribution without datapacks with a mod like:
- [Cristel Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/cristel-lib)
- [Sparse Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/sparsestructures)

You can configure it with a datapack and enable it by default in all worlds with:
- [Global Packs](https://modrinth.com/mod/globalpacks)
